svg.text: The simulated network: a fat-tree of 6-port switches (k = 6)
Every switch has k = 6 ports, half down and half up. Each of the 6 pods has 3 edge and 3 aggregation switches; 9 core switches link the pods.
Switches: 18 + 18 + 9 = 45. Servers: 6 pods × 3 edge switches × 3 servers = 54. Each tier has as much capacity up as down: full bisection bandwidth.
Longest path (blue): 6 links of 2 µs, so 24 µs round trip; at 40 Gb/s, a BDP of 120 KB.
